Tom, saw Corcentric leaning into Capital Equipment Solutions with a new VP hire and the Unite and Workato expansions.

When the motion expands like that, there are usually more in-market fleet and finance buyers than your reps can cover, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Corcentric off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

As the capital equipment line scales, the target list grows faster than the team does, and most groups cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number. So the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Corcentric needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Corcentric's reply rate likely compares to other B2B fintech and procurement firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
